title: Certify finite globally optimal passive cells with both compliance and stiffness charged
statement: A proper Bose dual with five distinct positive edges and positive compliance/stiffness inequality multipliers has at most five positive roots and proves the three-band star globally optimal at its exact resources. Its strictly negative-definite resource Jacobian gives an analytic inverse onto the proper five-root image and an open local family near normalized (C,kappa)=(1/20,24). Exact finite two-pendant optima are separately constructed at caps 24 and 20.02. No complete global resource phase diagram is established.

requires: Connected finite positive scalar spring/mass networks with one rank-one intercell backbone link
Full-spectrum ideal-contact harmonic ballistic Bose objective
Defined relative-CM compliance, fixed actual masses and supplied positive K/theta
Actual positive strict three-band star, exact trace/log moments and all five dual-edge equations
Proper multiplier signs and exact-root existence at each claimed budget
provides: Graph-wide fourth moment E=16+8*kappa_incident<=16+8*kappa_total charges every internal spring
Two active internal resonances are necessary/sufficient at those points; hardware and dark modes need not be unique
Fourteen individually certified family points and a genuine local analytic family, not every intervening or feasible tuple
A rational-decimal cell with spring sum 20.0199 and C<1/20 has separate gain about 1.83396196008e-7; feasible near optimum, not the exact optimizer or a tolerance theorem
assumptions: No vector, anharmonic, finite-contact, connector-mass, geometry/strain or measured-device transfer
No historical-priority or algorithmic advantage established; conventional designers receive the same synthesis information
Proper-image/local invertibility is not surjectivity onto all feasible resources
Cap 20.02 owns its nested-root and infinite-tail certificate; no globality inferred from optimization or a three-moment certificate
costs: Two side masses/springs and every optical band charged; small added mass and tiny gain explicit
Exact nested-root isolation, interval arithmetic and positive inverse synthesis
No uniform conditioning or manufacturing tolerance; conventional synthesis gets the same information
contract.units: Normalized source mass/frequency units; kappa is the sum of every positive internal spring; J has conductance factor k_B/(2pi)
contract.obstruction: Closes named finite-budget optima and a local/proper-image family. Global joint coverage, physical realization and algorithmic superiority remain open.
